findings.body: The integration tests sign in only through /test-auth/sign-in. They never exercise Google start or callback, so the state cookie, token verification, prelaunch rejection redirect, and saved return path could break while the suite passes. Add a test through the Google endpoints with Google faked at its external boundary.
findings.title: Not done: Google sign-in end-to-end test

findings.body: The test calls the cleanup service directly. Removing or misconfiguring its daily Cron registration would leave this test green while unfinished sign-ins linger. Exercise the scheduled job through the running application and check the 30-day cutoff.
findings.title: Not done: daily 30-day cleanup schedule test

findings.body: The suite enables the identity-spoofing test route but never starts the application with production settings to verify that the route is absent. A regression in this conditional registration could expose sign-in without Google verification in production. Add a production-configuration HTTP test that expects the route to be unavailable.
findings.title: Not done: production test-auth exclusion test

findings.body: The generated OpenAPI document defines a security scheme named `cookie`, but the protected operations reference `cwf_session`. That reference cannot resolve, so clients and validators cannot interpret the advertised authentication contract. Give the scheme and operation references the same name.
findings.title: Fix the OpenAPI cookie security scheme reference

findings.body: Onboarding rejects requests unless a published notice exists, while this branch creates only the table and explicitly defers publication to T3. Until T3 supplies the approved notice, a real new sign-in cannot finish onboarding. The integration test succeeds because it inserts a test notice.
findings.title: Later: T3 must publish a privacy notice before onboarding can complete

findings.body: This new Forge task-status record is outside the permitted paths and is not needed for the sign-in API, contract, or account-setup checklist.
findings.title: Remove the unrelated task-state file
